title: Reader security
description: Keys for securing Attractap readers over the air. Secured readers only accept updates signed by these keys.
warning: The signing key is lost if you lose the database or AUTH_SESSION_SECRET and also every signing key backup. If the recovery key is lost as well, secured readers can never be updated again. Keep the recovery file and a signing key backup somewhere safe, apart from each other, together with their passphrases.
loadFailed: The key status could not be loaded.
notLicensed: Reader security is not included in this instance's license.
locked: {{count}} reader(s) have Secure Boot digests burned in, so the keys cannot be regenerated.

recovery.title: Download recovery key
recovery.description: The file is encrypted with a passphrase you choose. Neither the file nor the passphrase is stored here. You can download it again until you have checked it.

check.title: Check recovery key
check.description: Upload the recovery file you downloaded and enter its passphrase. If it matches, the server deletes its copy of the recovery key and readers can be secured.

restore.title: Restore keys
restore.description: Upload a signing key backup or the recovery file with its passphrase. After restoring from the recovery file, a fresh recovery key is created that you must check again.
restore.replaces: This replaces the current signing key, so earlier backups of it no longer match. Restoring the recovery file also replaces the recovery key with a new one.

regenerate.title: Regenerate keys?
regenerate.description: This replaces both keys. Downloaded recovery files and backups of the old keys stop being useful. It is only possible while no reader has this installation's keys burned in.

whatToBackup.title: What to back up
whatToBackup.secret: AUTH_SESSION_SECRET: without it the stored keys cannot be decrypted.
whatToBackup.database: The database, which holds the encrypted signing key and the reader records.
whatToBackup.recovery: The recovery key file and its passphrase.
whatToBackup.signingBackup: A signing key backup and its passphrase.

backup.title: Download signing key backup
backup.description: The backup is encrypted with a passphrase you choose and can be read with openssl. Decrypt a temporary copy before using it with espsecure. Neither the file nor the passphrase is stored here.
